name: Divinations
description: Rolled once during character creation: the character's strange and twisted destiny. Dark Heresy Second Edition, Table 2-9 (p. 84). The `effect` on each row is the part the builder applies automatically; a row whose effect depends on what the character already has, or which offers a choice, is left to the player.

results.name: Mutation without, corruption within.
results.text: Roll once on Table 8–15: Malignancies (see page 290) and apply the result.

results.name: Trust in your fear.
results.text: Increase this character's Perception by 5. He also gains the Phobia Mental Disorder (see page 288).

results.name: Humans must die so that humanity can endure.
results.text: This character gains the Jaded talent. If he already possesses this talent, increase his Willpower characteristic by 2 instead.

results.name: The pain of the bullet is ecstasy compared to damnation.
results.text: Reduce this character's Agility characteristic by 3. The first time this character suffers Critical damage each session, roll 1d10. On a result of 10, he does not suffer any Critical Effects, though the damage still counts as Critical damage.

results.name: Be a boon to your allies and the bane of your enemies.
results.text: This character gains the Hatred (choose any one) talent. If he already possessed this talent, increase his Strength characteristic by 2 instead.

results.name: The wise learn from the deaths of others.
results.text: Increase this character's Agility or Intelligence characteristic by 3. Reduce his Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill characteristic by 3.

results.name: Kill the alien before it can speak its lies.
results.text: This character gains the Quick Draw talent. If he already possesses this talent, increase his Agility characteristic by 2 instead.

results.name: Truth is subjective.
results.text: Increase this character's Perception characteristic by 3. The first time he would gain 1 or more Corruption points each session, he gains that amount plus 1 instead.

results.name: Thought begets Heresy.
results.text: Reduce this character's Intelligence characteristic by 3. The first time he would gain 1 or more Corruption points each session, he reduces that amount by 1 (to a minimum of 0) instead.

results.name: Heresy begets Retribution.
results.text: Increase this character's Fellowship or Strength characteristic by 3. Reduce his Toughness or Willpower characteristic by 3.

results.name: A mind without purpose wanders in dark places.
results.text: When gaining Mental Disorders (see page 287), the character may choose to gain a new Disorder instead of increasing the severity of an existing Disorder.

results.name: If a job is worth doing, it is worth dying for.
results.text: Increase this character's Toughness or Willpower characteristic by 3. Reduce his Fellowship or Strength characteristic by 3.

results.name: Dark dreams lie upon the heart.
results.text: Whenever this character would roll on Table 8–15: Malignancies (see page 290), he may instead select any one result and gain that Malignancy.

results.name: Violence solves everything.
results.text: Increase this character's Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill characteristic by 3. Reduce his Agility or Intelligence characteristic by 3.

results.name: Ignorance is a wisdom of its own.
results.text: Reduce this character's Perception characteristic by 3. The first time he would gain 1 or more Insanity points each session, he reduces that amount by 1 (to a minimum of 0) instead.

results.name: Only the insane have strength enough to prosper.
results.text: Increase this character's Willpower characteristic by 3. The first time he would gain 1 or more Insanity points each session, he gains that amount plus 1 instead.

results.name: A suspicious mind is a healthy mind.
results.text: Increase this character's Perception characteristic by 2. Additionally, he may re-roll Awareness tests to avoid being Surprised.

results.name: Suffering is an unrelenting instructor.
results.text: Reduce this character's Toughness characteristic by 3. The first time that this character suffers any damage each session, he gains a +20 bonus to the next test he makes before the end of his next turn.

results.name: The only true fear is dying without your duty done.
results.text: This character gains the Resistance (Cold, Heat, or Fear) talent. If he already possesses this talent, increase his Toughness characteristic by 2 instead.

results.name: Only in death does duty end.
results.text: The first time this character would suffer Fatigue each session, he suffers that amount of Fatigue minus 1 (to a minimum of 0) instead.

results.name: Innocence is an illusion.
results.text: This character gains the Keen Intuition talent. If he already possesses this talent, increase his Intelligence characteristic by 2 instead.

results.name: To war is human.
results.text: This character gains the Dodge skill as a Known skill (rank 1). If he already possesses this skill, increase his Agility characteristic by 2 instead.

results.name: There is no substitute for zeal.
results.text: This character gains the Clues from the Crowds talent. If he already possesses this talent, increase his Fellowship characteristic by 2 instead.

results.name: Even one who has nothing can still offer his life.
results.text: When this character burns Fate threshold to survive a lethal injury, roll 1d10. On a result of 10, he survives whatever grievous wound would have killed him but does not reduce his Fate threshold.

results.name: Do not ask why you serve. Only ask how.
results.text: Increase this character's Fate threshold by 1.
